name: md-editor
description: Markdown editor with a project library and themed PDF export (macOS).

scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mde/ui && npm run build -w @mde/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @mde/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w @mde/desktop
